column3: “At dawn” is supplied after “does not fail”.
“Shoulder to shoulder” renders the singular expression “one shoulder”.
“My scattered people” replaces “the daughter of My scattered ones”.
“Meek and humble” renders the afflicted and poor people.
“Quiet you with His love” makes His being silent into an action that quiets the addressee.
“So that you will no longer suffer reproach” replaces the statement about the burden of reproach.
